files.Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = ["crates/core", "crates/cli"]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"

[workspace.dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0.203", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.117"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1

# crates/core/Cargo.toml and crates/cli/Cargo.toml inherit with:
# edition.workspace = true
# serde.workspace = true
# serde_json.workspace = true

# Test the whole workspace with: cargo test --workspace
